title: Most toys are some variation of bean bags filled with catnip
text: About 70% of items I got over 3-4 months were beanbags in shapes/prints to fit the monthly theme, filled with catnip. My cat loves the Yeowww banana, so you would think that would be a hit. But the catnip must not be that great. The treats are hit and miss. Also, besides the treats, all the toys are made by Kitnip Box, even though they label them as separate brands. The labels say they’re all produced in the same place. If you’re looking for variety, this is not the box for you.
label: neutral
